content: Metabolic surgery, also known as bariatric or weight-loss surgery, is a proven and effective treatment for managing type 2 diabetes and obesity. Surgical procedures like Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) and sleeve gastrectomy (VSG) work by reducing the size of the stomach, thereby limiting food intake, and in some cases, bypassing portions of the digestive tract to alter nutrient absorption. These interventions have demonstrated sustained improvements in blood glucose control, reductions in A1C levels, and decreased cardiovascular risk factors. Importantly, the benefits of these surgeries are observed regardless of the patient’s body mass index (BMI), making them a viable therapeutic option for a broad spectrum of individuals.
